The 2025 text explicitly names new specific competitors: Sandisk Corporation, ChangXin Memory Technologies, Inc. (CXMT), and Yangtze Memory Technologies Co., Ltd. (YMTC). comparisons.peer_summary: AMD expects competition to remain intense due to rapid technological changes and competitors introducing products with better performance or features that could render AMD's products less competitive.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies explicitly disclose that competition in their respective semiconductor markets will remain intense due to rapid technological change and competitors introducing superior products. Micron warns that competitors may use aggressive pricing to gain share (mu_2024_1_P049_S002), while AMD expects intense competition driven by technological changes and new product introductions that could render its products less competitive (amd_2024_1_P063_S003).

sentences.text: We face intense competition in the semiconductor memory and storage markets from a number of companies, including Kioxia Holdings Corporation; Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.; SK hynix Inc.; and Western Digital Corporation.
Our competitors may use aggressive pricing to obtain market share.

We expect that competition will continue to be intense due to rapid technological changes, frequent product introductions by our competitors or new competitors of products that may provide better performance or experiences or that may include additional features that render our products comparatively less competitive.

comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom operates in highly competitive markets where a consolidation trend is expected to continue, alongside increasing competition from existing competitors expanding offerings and new market entrants. Effectiveness depends on factors such as quality, price, innovation, and customer support.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies identify industry consolidation as a key feature of the competitive landscape that poses risks or changes the market dynamics. Micron states that consolidation of competitors could put it at a disadvantage by creating rivals with greater scale and resources (mu_2024_1_P049_S003, mu_2024_1_P049_S004). Similarly, Broadcom notes that the competitive landscape is changing due to a trend toward consolidation and expects this trend to continue, with competitors merging or collaborating (avgo_2024_1_P038_S003, avgo_2024_1_P038_S004).

sentences.text: Some of our competitors are large corporations or conglomerates that may have a larger market share and greater resources to invest in technology, capitalize on growth opportunities, and withstand downturns in the semiconductor markets in which we compete.
Consolidation of industry competitors could put us at a competitive disadvantage as our competitors may benefit from increased manufacturing scale and a stronger product portfolio.

The competitive landscape is changing as a result of a trend toward consolidation within many industries, as some of our competitors have merged with or been acquired by other competitors, while others have begun collaborating with each other.
We expect this consolidation trend to continue.

comparisons.peer_summary: The market for the company's products is intensely competitive, driven by factors such as performance, product breadth, software support, and pricing. Competition is expected to increase from existing and new entrants, including alliances, potentially offering lower prices or better performance.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies describe their markets as intensely competitive and highlight that competitors may offer products with better performance or lower prices, potentially eroding market share. Micron notes competitors may use aggressive pricing to obtain market share (mu_2024_1_P049_S002). NVIDIA states that competition is expected to increase from entrants with products that may be lower priced or provide better performance/features (nvda_2024_1_P045_S004). Both also emphasize rapid technological change as a driver of this competition.

sentences.text: Our competitors may use aggressive pricing to obtain market share.
The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change and evolving industry standards.

We expect competition to increase from both existing competitors and new market entrants with products that may be lower priced than ours or may provide better performance or additional features not provided by our products.

comparisons.peer_summary: QCT operates in an intensely competitive industry with many U.S. and international competitors, including Broadcom, Nvidia, and Samsung. Competition is driven by performance, integration, quality, and price, with risks including rapid technological change, customer vertical integration, and high barriers to entry in the automotive sector due to regulatory and safety requirements.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies face intense competition driven by factors including rapid technological change and the resource capabilities of rivals. Micron highlights that some competitors are large corporations with greater resources to invest in technology and withstand downturns (mu_2024_1_P049_S003). Qualcomm similarly notes that competitors devote significant financial, technical, and other resources to develop competitive products, and that technological changes and industry consolidation keep the industry very competitive (qcom_2024_1_P037_S005, qcom_2024_1_P038_S003).

sentences.text: Some of our competitors are large corporations or conglomerates that may have a larger market share and greater resources to invest in technology, capitalize on growth opportunities, and withstand downturns in the semiconductor markets in which we compete.

As a result of global expansion by foreign and domestic competitors, technological changes, device manufacturer concentrations, limited global supply capacity, vertical integration and the potential for further industry consolidation, we anticipate the industry to remain very competitive.

Our competitors devote significant amounts of their financial, technical and other resources to develop and market competitive products and, in some cases, to develop and adopt competitive digital communication or signal processing technologies, and those efforts may materially and adversely affect us.
